method: OpenAI built-in image_gen; map and visitor assets are separate from native HTML labels and controls

prompts.campus_concept_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Use the attached isometric office illustration ONLY as the style and spatial-story reference. Create a complete, production-design concept screenshot of a Korean interactive HTML curriculum-exploration game, 1536x1024 landscape. Brand 'BIADON EDU'. This is an actual playable miniature campus UI, not a marketing landing page, not a static infographic. Main task: move a small human visitor with arrow keys along the corridor and enter seven course rooms to read what they learn and make. The user wants the cozy hand-inked isometric office/architectural cutaway feeling of the reference with plants, wooden desks, computer screens and people working, but polished readable native HTML UI and restrained color. No robots, magic sparkles, glows, stock AI gradients, XP bars, coins or badges unrelated to courses. Background true warm white #f7f7f3, thin charcoal ink outlines #222b32, cobalt #3437ee. Rooms distinguished with small flat course colors: F blue, A cyan, B violet, C coral, D orange, E green, T purple. Header at top left simple black BIADON EDU with a tiny cobalt square, top right actual controls '전체 커리큘럼' and '조작 방법'. Under header left exact heading '내 사업에 필요한 AI를 한 공간에서.' and small text '방향키로 걷고, 수업의 문을 열어보세요.' Main playable world occupies the left 1120x730 region with no giant enclosing rounded card. Create a single-level seven-room isometric school with one obvious wide connected central corridor, four studios along the far bank and three along the near bank; all doors face corridor and remain unobstructed. NOT stairs or disconnected islands. This flat plan is needed for real 2D movement. Seven roofless studios: F at front-center near entrance = orientation desk + pinned business sheets; A far-left = camera, light, content desk; B far-upper-left = website design computers; C far-upper-right = two customer-message monitors; D far-right = spreadsheet and bar-chart workstation; E near-right = small tool-building workbench; T near-left = three team desks with shared planning board. The rich building illustration must feel like the supplied reference, not flat geometric UI boxes. Leave corridor floor spacious, blank, clean and walkable. One brown-haired visitor in white top, dark trousers and small black backpack stands in the central corridor at the entrance. Place real-looking small code-native course signs near each room: '기초 내 사업에 AI 적용하기', 'A 홍보 콘텐츠', 'B 소개·문의 웹페이지', 'C 고객 문의 자동화', 'D 매출 분석·보고서', 'E 나만의 업무 도구', '심화 AI 업무팀'. Room signs are neat flat white placards with small colored square letters, thin borders, no heavy shadows, no baked distorted Korean. Right sidebar 300px wide separated by a fine vertical rule, heading '어느 방부터 가볼까요?' followed small paragraph '지금 내 사업에 필요한 수업을 골라보세요.' Below, a compact plain list of seven course names with colored letter labels and right arrows, not seven rounded cards. A bottom sidebar link '운영 안내 · 비용·보안·복구'. Bottom of map a modest control strip with real native keyboard keycaps '↑ ↓ ← → 이동', 'Enter 입장', 'Esc 나오기'. Bottom-right small real state '둘러본 방 0 / 7'. Entire primary screen and interactions visible, no browser frame or device mockup, crisp Korean type using Pretendard. Native UI controls and labels must remain separable from illustration and implementable in HTML. Maintain air, mature readability, clear room/door placement. The design concept must include the full map, sidebar and bottom controls within frame.
prompts.campus_map_prompt: Edit this concept into a standalone production game-world background asset. Keep EXACTLY the same illustrated seven-room building, rooms, camera angle, thin hand-inked architectural cutaway style, warm wooden desks, light stone corridor floor, plants, receptionist and people working INSIDE rooms. Remove ALL website UI, headings, sidebar, bottom controls, all floating room placards/signs, every letter/word/number/logo on walls, doors, floor mats and monitors, and REMOVE the single visitor with backpack standing at the front entrance. Keep workers seated inside rooms. All computer screens should show only simple unlabeled blue interface shapes. The entire image must contain just the isometric seven-room school, no surrounding text and no controls. Enlarge and recenter the complete building on a 1536x1152 transparent canvas with 28px minimum clear alpha margin around the outer silhouette, no cropping of furniture or architecture. The room layout remains: A content studio far-left; B website office upper-left; C customer office upper-right; D spreadsheet office far-right; E tools workshop front-right; F reception/foundation front-center; T three-desk teamwork room front-left. IMPORTANT for playable motion: open the doors on every corridor-facing room wall so all seven rooms have a visibly open doorway connecting to the central light stone courtyard/corridor; in particular T and E need an open passage on their inner side toward courtyard, while F has an open doorway on its left inner side. Keep the broad central corridor clean and empty, connected to the front entrance by a clear walkable passage around the left side of the F reception room; do not put new furniture or plants in these passages. No magic sparks, no glow, no glossy 3D render, no gradients or new decorative elements. Faithfully preserve the coherent office-illustration identity of the reference. Background outside the building is fully transparent, internal floors and walls remain opaque.
prompts.campus_sprite_prompt: Create a production transparent character sprite sheet for the attached illustrated office-world reference. Only the visitor character, no architecture or text. The visitor has short slightly wavy brown hair, cream-white long-sleeved casual shirt, charcoal trousers, white sneakers and a small simple black backpack. Same charming hand-inked, softly colored, mature Korean office architectural-illustration style as reference, thin consistent charcoal outlines, restrained natural shading. No glossy 3D, no pixel art, no chibi oversize head, no icons. 1536x1024 canvas, an EXACT uniform 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet, each cell384x512. EACH CELL HAS ONE COMPLETE full-body character, centered at x=192 relative to cell, character same scale and height about410px, soles of shoes at y=480 relative to cell in every frame. Leave broad transparent padding and no cell borders or labels. Columns from left to right are facing screen DOWN/front three-quarter, LEFT/profile three-quarter, RIGHT/profile three-quarter, UP/back three-quarter. First row: relaxed standing pose. Second row: matching mid-stride walking pose with one foot forward and subtle arm movement. The character must remain the SAME identity, clothes, proportions, backpack and angle across frames, no different people, all feet fully in frame. Backpack should appear naturally on back in each orientation. Keep the head slightly turned into each direction so facial direction is legible at 70px render height. Fully transparent alpha background in every gap; no cast shadow, no ground plane, no white rectangle, no floor, no words. This is a functional 8-frame game sprite, exact grid alignment matters.
prompts.campus_detail_prompt: Create one full 1536x1024 desktop UI state for the attached BIADON EDU playable illustrated-campus design. Preserve its native HTML typography (Pretendard), warm white #f7f7f3, charcoal ink and cobalt accents. This state is AFTER the small visitor enters the A content studio. The campus map remains subtly dimmed behind one large flat white course-booklet dialog, centered at x230..1310 and y95..930, thin ink border, modest shadow, no rounded generic cards or glows. Real native control at top right '방에서 나오기 ×'. Dialog has a 340px left editorial column separated by fine rule from a spacious right column. Top left small cyan A square and '선택 A · 총 4시간'. Exact full title on left in 36px bold, carefully balanced 4 lines: '조회수 1만 회를 노리는\nAI 홍보 콘텐츠 제작법'. Time '2시간 × 2회'. Below small header '완성하는 결과물', then large plain native text '홍보 이미지·게시물\n+ 제작 템플릿'. Beneath short paragraph '고객이 멈춰 보는 문구와 이미지, 반복해서 쓸 제작 템플릿을 만듭니다.' No practice widgets, input fields or demos. Right column heading '이 방에서 배우는 것' at 28px, followed SEVEN readable ruled numbered items in 18px: '조회수 높은 콘텐츠의 첫 3초 후킹 분석하기', '고객이 멈춰 보는 제목·썸네일 기획하기', 'GPT로 릴스 대본·홍보 문구 만들기', '실제 상품 사진으로 AI 홍보 이미지 제작하기', '우리 브랜드의 색상·폰트·자막 템플릿 만들기', '짧은 영상의 자막·장면 구성 실습하기 (선택)', '게시 후 조회수·클릭·문의 반응 점검하기'. At bottom a restrained small note '조회수 1만 회는 도전 목표이며 성과를 보장하지 않습니다.' Footer one fine rule and controls 'Esc 지도 돌아가기' and '다음 방으로 걸어가기 →'. Native code-like crisp UI, complete uncut dialog within frame, readable controls, no fake generated metrics. Retain small map details in background and right nav behind scrim; this is a real accessible course-information dialog, not a brochure image.
prompts.campus_open_map_prompt: Modify only the room-to-courtyard openness of this existing seven-room isometric office game map. Preserve the same camera, composition, outer building silhouette, seven rooms, furnishings, workers, plants, warm hand-inked rendering, transparent exterior and overall image size. This is a playable walking map, so the visitor must be able to walk along a clearly VISIBLE connected floor, not appear to walk over a drawn wall. Keep the four rear studios and their open doorways intact. For the three FRONT rooms, remove ALL walls/door frames that face the central courtyard: the back/upper-left diagonal wall of the front-center reception room, the inner upper-right wall of the front-left three-person teamwork room, and the inner upper-left wall of the front-right tool room. Make those three courtyard-facing edges completely OPEN with continuous flat light floor thresholds, no tall wall, no closed door and no furniture crossing the threshold. Keep all outer-facing walls and their cutaway details as before so the rooms still feel architectural, but the central court must flow visibly to each of the seven room floors. The front-center reception counter remains, moved slightly toward the front-right if needed so its LEFT side forms a clear wide passage from front entrance to central courtyard. Furniture should stay at the periphery, leaving a broad empty lane in front of it. Remove no desks or workers. Do NOT add characters in the courtyard. No signs, no text, no labels, no logos, no UI. Preserve real alpha transparency outside the building. Everything at one floor level, no steps between rooms. Retain high-quality natural linework without glow or glossy 3D.
